title: Governance Platform Hardening
objective: Make the governance platform itself deterministic, trustworthy, and self-consistent before allowing it to govern the repository.

phase_0.title: Governance Architecture Freeze
phase_0.purpose: Freeze the governance platform architecture before implementing WS1-WS9.

specification_drift_policy.policy: After Phase 0.75, no workstream may modify frozen architecture or specifications.
specification_drift_policy.process: If implementation reveals incorrect specification, implementation must stop. Change must be proposed through new ADR and specification update. Only after specification update may implementation continue.
specification_drift_policy.purpose: Prevent 'fixing the spec in code' and keep architecture as source of truth.

status_note: 8 of 9 workstreams (WS1 Root Detection, WS2 Closure Engine, WS3 Validator Framework, WS5 Database Consolidation, WS6 Freeze Framework, WS7 Evidence System, WS8 Metrics Engine, WS9 Integrity Engine) are fully IMPLEMENTED against every readiness-checklist item, verified live via 7 successive independent fresh-clone re-verifications (each of which found and led to fixing a real defect: 2 non-determinism bugs, an unverifiable-from-fresh-clone tamper-evidence scheme, 2 evidence directories not surviving git clone, an overly strict freeze-staleness check, and a keypair-corruption risk in test isolation). WS4 (Knowledge Graph) remains PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED: event_graph/schema_graph are genuinely empty (zero documents in the 277-document corpus populate the required events_produced/events_consumed/schemas metadata fields -- a corpus data-completeness limitation, not a code defect), and graph-vs-source-document cross-validation is not yet built as a feature distinct from IntegrityEngine's existing structural sanity check. See .governance/programme_2.5/WORKSTREAM-STATUS-ROLLUP.json and each ws{N}/manifest.json for full itemized, live-executed evidence.
